annotations.title: What to fix on one website

description: A verified website's latest findings, by fixed rules (never a model), ranked by its goal: each with its effect, evidence numbers, likely causes and what to try; minor ones marked. Returns the top `limit` (default 10) with `total` and `more_available`; page on with `offset` (`next_offset`). An agent gets a summary of each (key numbers and first step, no evidence lists), cut to fit its reply; webops_finding gives one in full. The ranking is the whole list's, so the first page is the true top. Another organization's site answers not found. Read-only.

limit.description: How many findings, highest ranked first (default 10).

offset.description: Skip this many ranked findings first, for the next page (default 0).

name: webops_findings
